sections.installation:
From Dashboard ( WordPress admin )

  • Go to the “Plugins” screen, click “Add New”, and search for “Checkout with Zelle on Woocommerce” in the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  • Click “Install Now” and after that’s complete, click “Activate”.

Getting a downloaded zip

  • Download ‘Checkout with Zelle on Woocommerce’ from either:
  • The African Boss for the PRO version
  • WordPress for the free version

Uploading a downloaded zip in the Dashboard ( WordPress admin )

  • Go to the “Plugins” screen and click “Add New”.
  • Click “Upload Plugin” and select the downloaded zip file.
  • Click “Install Now” and after that’s complete, click “Activate”.

Using cPanel or FTP

  • Unzip ‘wc-zelle.zip’ file and
  • Upload wc-zelle folder to the “/wp-content/plugins/” directory.
  • Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.

After Plugin Activation

Find and click Zelle in your admin dashboard left sidebar to access Zelle settings

or

Go to ‘Woocommerce > Settings > Payments’ screen to configure the plugin

Also you can visit the plugin page for further setup instructions.
sections.faq:
Does this Zelle plugin integrate with the Zelle payment APIs?

This plugin is a quick and easy way to display to your customers your Zelle information.
Unfortunately, this plugin doesn’t integrate with your bank or the Zelle app as an end-to-end payment.
It only displays your Zelle information to the customer so that the customer can know how to proceed in their Zelle/bank app.

What is emailreceipts.io and do I need to integrate it?

emailreceipts.io is a service that allows you to track Zelle payments and update order statuses automatically.
The integration also helps send automated emails to your customers when their order status changes.
If you do not want to use emailreceipts.io, you will have to manually update the order status in your Woocommerce admin dashboard.

Support

Premium Support

Users with a valid Checkout with Zelle on Woocommerce PRO license receive Priority Support, directly from the plugin developer! Find out more!

Community Support for users of the Free version

For support questions, bug reports, or feature requests, please use the WordPress Support Forums. Please search through the forums first, and only create a new topic if you don’t find an existing answer. Thank you!

Languages and Localization

Also compatible with Translation plugins (like Loco, WPML, etc) meaning you can translate the Checkout, Thank you page and Email notices

SMS for Woocommerce compatibility

Also using our SMS for Woocommerce plugin, you can send personalized bulk email and SMS notifications for orders still on-hold with order information and more
sections.changelog:
5.0-5.1 May-Oct 15, 2026

  • Added a popup design (PRO) that opens on Place order and shows Zelle payment details in a dialog, like modern payment methods
  • Added support for the popup design for Zelle info on the checkout page
  • Applied the popup experience to the WooCommerce classic checkout and Blocks checkout
  • The checkout popup shows the order number as the payment memo and amount, on both classic and block checkout
  • Popup orders stay as pending payment (no more drafts) while the popup is open, go on-hold once the customer confirms, and go to processing/completed when emailreceipts.io matches the payment
  • An order paid while its popup was open goes straight to its order confirmation page
  • Improved order stock and coupon management in the popup
  • Popup falls back to a normal Place order submission if JavaScript is unavailable or the popup fails to open
  • The Checkout Page Notice now appears inside the popup
  • Added the Zelle Tag field and setting
  • Improved Zelle payment links and Zelle QR code handling
  • Removed the “Sender’s Zelle Tag/Email/Phone Number” field at checkout
  • Restyled the Copy buttons as secondary and stopped reading their values from hidden inputs
  • Popup content reuses WooCommerce’s own button, input and form-row classes instead of custom styling
  • Simplified checkout.css to remove non-essential classes so the checkout adapts to any active theme
  • Better enqueue handling for scripts and styles
  • Unpaid on-hold Zelle orders are cancelled automatically once WooCommerce’s “Hold stock (minutes)” passes, like pending orders
  • Added syncing with emailreceipts.io accounts
  • Refactored code across plugin for better performance
  • Updated PHP, Freemius, Woocommerce and WordPress compatibility

  • Fixed [E_DEPRECATED] Creation of dynamic property with AllowDynamicProperties

  • Fixed wc_get_orders matching orders for processing in wc_zelle_find_zelle_order
  • Fixed load_plugin_textdomain was called incorrectly error with init load_plugin_textdomain and get_plugin_data fix
  • Refactored code across plugin for better performance
  • Updated Freemius, Woocommerce and WordPress compatibility
